intent: style-transfer concept exploration; not production sprites

prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: original raster visual-direction concept for a real Apple Watch pickleball game, not a production game screenshot. Input image 1 is the layout and gameplay reference. Produce one portrait gameplay screen in the same 422:514 aspect ratio, filling the entire image; no watch hardware, poster framing, comparison board, or explanatory text.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION LOCK: preserve the exact court corner positions and perspective, exact positions and approximate visible sizes of both athletes, their same ready poses and facing directions, same cyan/white regulation line topology (20x44-foot court, seven-foot non-volley zones, center service lines only outside non-volley zone, net at midfield), same lime pickleball position by the far opponent, same gray oval ground cue at center net, same small cyan landing cross near the player's left, same score-panel position/text. Keep the player about the original 47-point visible height and boss about 33 points; do not enlarge them into promotional characters. Keep whole near service court as OPEN NEGATIVE SPACE. Court interior is perfectly flat true OLED black (#000000), except the existing thin court lines, ball, athletes, and tiny cues: absolutely no floor texture, gradients, glow wash, shadows across playing surface, fog, extra markings or reflections. Court geometry and HUD must remain as readable as reference.
The blue-and-white backwards-cap athlete with blue sportswear is back-facing at near baseline; the purple hooded Lobber is front-facing at far baseline. Keep their paddles connected to hands; no second paddles, detached limbs, extra characters on court, motion trails, huge ball, poster text, marketing artwork, or watermark. HUD reads exactly "YOU 2 R6" on left and "S2 BOSS 1" on right, in small crisp readable bright type on black. Reserve the top clock area, like reference. Upgrade character/raster artistry substantially: fresh professionally authored anatomical forms, pleasing weight and body language, readable sporting equipment, intentional material/color separation. Keep gameplay silhouette and composition even if refining costume detail.
DIRECTION A — PREMIUM PAINTED TOURNAMENT. Give the tiny athletes the finish of premium high-end 3D-toon sports-game renders translated into painterly sprites: solid appealing anatomical volumes, refined sneaker shapes, fabric folds that collapse into clear color blocks, dimensional paddles with bevel/rim/material, rich but controlled blue/white player and violet/plum Lobber. Gentle warm amber rim light on shoulders/cap/paddle edges plus cool moonlight creates depth without an aura. No plastic shine or pixel-art. Environment outside the court: a beautifully art-directed midnight pickleball resort with sculptural tropical foliage, distant misty mountains and one small moon; warm architectural sideline luminaires, premium deep-blue courtside structures, restrained photographic material richness. Refined dark anodized court-edge frame with sparse warm amber corner hardware, brighter icy-white regulation lines with a narrow cyan rim. Everything outside the court stays dark and subordinate, with lighting baked into the painted artwork. Aim for a real premium mobile/console sports aesthetic with craft and atmosphere, not generic neon cyberpunk.
